data.cultural_impact: The name Gleeson, originating from the Old Irish word Glas, often signified a "foreigner" or "stranger" in the Celtic culture. Historical records reveal that the name became popular among the native Irish population after the invasions by the Vikings, Anglo-Saxons, and Normans. The name resonated with those who were culturally different, crafting an aura of curiosity and respect within the community.
